title: asm1-kalman-pinn: Kalman filter versus physics-informed neural network for never-measured ASM1 states
description: Code, configurations, tests and pre-registration of a synthetic-data study on a BSM1-layout activated sludge facility: which of the 55 never-measured Activated Sludge Model No. 1 (ASM1) tank states can routine dissolved oxygen, ammonium, nitrate and solids probes recover, and does any estimator (persistence, open-loop simulation, extended Kalman filtering and smoothing, or a physics-informed neural network) still beat holding the start state once the model kinetics are textbook defaults rather than the facility's own. The generated datasets, training runs, estimator outputs, figures and tables are archived with the code.
